name: io.github.srikrishnal/bomscout
title: bomscout (Dependency-Track)
description: Ask which projects a CVE affects, what to fix first and license risk in OWASP Dependency-Track

environmentVariables.name: DT_URL
environmentVariables.description: Dependency-Track API server URL, e.g. https://dtrack.example.com

environmentVariables.name: DT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key of a team with VIEW_PORTFOLIO, VIEW_VULNERABILITY and VIEW_POLICY_VIOLATION

environmentVariables.name: DT_CA_BUNDLE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a CA bundle for a server with a private certificate

environmentVariables.name: BOMSCOUT_ALLOW_WRITE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to add the record_analysis tool for triage decisions
